products.description:
BOSCH PKE611BA2E 60 cm Electric Hob

The BOSCH PKE611BA2E Electric Hob is a sleek and reliable 60 cm glass-ceramic cooker designed for effortless daily cooking. With four well-spaced radiant cooking zones, precise touch controls, and advanced safety features, this electric hob makes cooking faster, cleaner, and more enjoyable in modern kitchens.

Spacious 60cm Design with 4 Cooking Zones

This Bosch electric hob offers enough space to cook multiple dishes at once. The four radiant zones support different pot and pan sizes, giving you flexibility for everyday meals and special occasions.

Cooking Zone Configuration:

  • Front Left: 145 mm – 1.2 kW
  • Rear Left: 180 mm – 2.0 kW
  • Rear Right: 145 mm – 1.2 kW
  • Front Right: 210 mm – 2.2 kW

Whether you’re simmering sauces or boiling water quickly, each zone delivers consistent and even heat.

TouchControl for Precise Heat Adjustment

The TouchControl +/- system (EntryTouch) allows you to adjust heat levels with simple touch buttons. Each cooking zone features 17 power levels, giving you fine control over temperature for perfect cooking results every time.

  • 9 main power levels
  • 8 intermediate levels for precision cooking
  • Quick response for smooth heat changes

Time-Saving and Smart Features

Bosch has added smart convenience features to make daily cooking easier and safer.

  • Restart function: Restores previous settings if the hob is turned back on within 4 seconds after accidental switch-off
  • Quick switch-off: Turn off a cooking zone instantly with a longer touch
  • Efficient radiant heating for consistent performance

Minimalist Frameless Design

The frameless glass-ceramic surface gives the hob a modern, built-in look that blends seamlessly with any kitchen countertop. It’s also easy to clean, as spills and splashes can be wiped away quickly.

Advanced Safety Features

Safety is a key strength of the BOSCH PKE611BA2E, making it suitable for family homes.

  • 2-stage residual heat indicator: Shows if a zone is still hot or warm
  • Safety lock: Prevents unintended operation, ideal for households with children
  • Main on/off switch: Instantly switches off all zones
  • Power-on indicator light: Confirms when the hob is active
  • Automatic safety switch-off: Stops heating after a preset time without interaction
